ttd_rate: TTD/PTD paid under AS 23.30.175(a); rate scales with the Alaska Average Weekly Wage (AAWW)
basis: Statutory formula tied to 2026 AAWW of $1,356 (AS 23.30.175)

A second, lower maximum ($1,424) applies specifically under AS 23.30.041(k) (rehabilitation-related); the $1,627 figure is the general TTD/PTD maximum.

ttd_rate: 66 2/3% of Average Monthly Wage (AMW), capped at the statutory maximum AMW
basis: Statutory maximum AMW of $6,131.00/month, converted to a weekly-equivalent (AMW x 12 / 52 x 66 2/3%) for comparability
notes: Arizona's system is monthly, not weekly: ICA confirms the CY2026 statutory maximum Average Monthly Wage is $6,131.00 for injuries 01/01/26-12/31/26. Weekly-equivalent max ($943.23) is a standard conversion (matches the SSA POMS cross-check figure exactly), not a figure ICA itself publishes as 'weekly.' No minimum AMW/weekly figure was located on the official page.
